name: io.github.wangyingsm/dr-strange
title: Dr Strange
description: Code graph for coding agents: who calls this, what a change reaches, in one round trip.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token>, when the server was started with DRSG_TOKEN set. A loopback server started without one accepts its own browser UI only.

environmentVariables.name: DRSG_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token the server requires of every client. Omit on a loopback bind to run without authentication.
